title: Golden Dutch Mushroom Pilaf
description: A classic Chinese-inspired dish featuring golden mushrooms and dutch pilaf, kissed with a hint of savory flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of kissed vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced golden mushrooms and cook until they're tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked Dutch pilaf, mushroom broth, soy sauce, grated ginger, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
Stir-fry everything together for about 2-3 minutes, until the pilaf is heated through.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions.
Note: You can customize this recipe to your taste by adding other vegetables, such as bell peppers or carrots.
